s0_prompt: 请直接描述这张图片中实际可见的内容，包括主要物体、它们的位置与可辨的相互关系；看不清的细节请明确说不确定。不要推断图片之前或之后发生了什么。
retry_only: At most one rerun of a technical failure when an attempt did not deliver a verified completed visible answer. Preserve all results. Never retry to improve the descriptive score.
s1_rule: After locking S0 adjudication, at most one fresh native session on each of the first two of [short_207720, short_213720, short_219720] with at least one omission or uncertainty, except two explicit errors on the same target. Use the prelocked neutral relationship prompt. Never use S1 to qualify S2.
s1_prompt: 请描述图中可辨的相互关系。请指出两件主要结构在画面上的轮廓是否有可辨的间隔；看不清请说明不确定。只描述画面，不推断时间过程。
s2_rule: A frame qualifies only if both independent S0 answers correctly state the registered target relation without a contradictory claim. Select the first qualified early short gap in [213720,207720,219720]; if none qualify, prefer qualified G3 2640 then 3240. The late short gap and overlap are controls, not substitutes for the difficult early cases.
s2_prompt: 请直接描述编号 1 图像中实际可见的内容，包括主要物体、它们的位置与可辨的相互关系；看不清的细节请明确说不确定。不要推断图片之前或之后发生了什么。若有多张独立图像，编号依附图顺序；若只有一张由多格组成的图，编号 1 为最左格；若只有一张完整图片，编号 1 就是这张图。
delivery_policy: Production first images and query results are independent, end-to-end source-sized PNG payloads at the observable SDK boundary. Never use a mosaic in this route. Do not modify history or infer model-internal image resolution.
